title: Fixed four-stock minute-panel proxy, 2021-2025 holdout
question: Pre-training-frozen CNN/temporal/cross-stock attention ensembles versus validation-selected GRU. Fixed four survivors and unresolved source adjustment provenance make this a proxy, not original AQuA reproduction. Success requires all five frozen component conditions. Forecast artifacts are local and not redistributed. Independent scalar covariance and round-trip-netting checks share the forecasts and market assumptions, not evaluator helper functions.

hypotheses.statement: Validation-selected CNN mean per-stock test Pearson IC is positive.
hypotheses.falsifier: Twenty-trading-day block interval wholly below zero refutes; zero-containing interval is inconclusive.

hypotheses.statement: Validation-selected CNN test IC improves over validation-selected GRU.
hypotheses.falsifier: Paired twenty-day block IC-difference interval wholly below zero refutes; zero-containing interval is inconclusive.

hypotheses.statement: CNN strategy has positive mean daily net PNL after one bp per unit absolute turnover.
hypotheses.falsifier: A wholly negative twenty-day block interval refutes; zero-containing interval or fewer than one hundred active intervals is inconclusive.

hypotheses.statement: Increasing turnover cost from one to five bp increases PNL on fixed positions.
hypotheses.falsifier: With nonzero turnover, lower stress PNL refutes; zero turnover is inconclusive.

hypotheses.statement: The fixed proxy satisfies every predeclared empirical success component.
hypotheses.falsifier: Any of IC lower bound, incremental IC lower bound, costed mean daily PNL lower bound with sufficient activity, positive stress PNL, or nonnegative each-year PNL fails. This is a joint decision rule, not proof that no profitable rule exists.
